decisions.reason: The platform dimensions provide clearance beneath the existing flush-mounted spouts but do not change their geometry, mounting location, orientation, material, or appearance.
Cup clearance and platform footprint do not alter the valve mechanism, dispensing sequence, flow behavior, or texture-preservation requirements.
The source specifies the support platform's dimensions and cup clearance without changing how the dispensing path must be removed, flushed, or cleaned.
Raising the mixer to accommodate cups does not change the existing leak-free bowl and spout sealing requirements.
The separate platform's height and footprint do not modify the requirement to isolate electrical components from liquid.
The source defines dimensions for a separately fabricated base but does not require reopening or revising the finalized component BOM or identify a new listed component.
External cup clearance beneath the spouts does not affect bowl lifting, swapping, or clearance from the whisk and motor assembly.
The platform dimensions do not change whisk geometry, whisk positioning, mixing quality, foam quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
Fitting the machine edge to edge on the platform does not change the placard wording, placement, duplication, or viewing orientations.
The raised external platform does not modify whisk removability, tool-free detachment, or clearance needed for bowl removal.
The 12-ounce value describes cups beneath the spouts, not mixing-bowl capacity or geometry, and the platform footprint does not change the bowl wells.
The support platform's height and footprint do not alter splash targets, guard policy, or high-speed splash-mitigation behavior.
